question: What was the sell-through rate for each product in September 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, round(100.0 * COALESCE(b.booked, 0) / NULLIF(i.total_placements, 0), 1) FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, delivery_month, sum(placements) AS booked FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY product_id, delivery_month) b ON b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month WHERE i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-09-01'

question: How many Video Pre-Roll placements are still available in November 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT i.total_placements - COALESCE((SELECT sum(placements) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status = 'active' AND b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month), 0) FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Video Pre-Roll' AND i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-11-01'

question: How many placements are available in total next month across all products?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(i.total_placements - COALESCE(b.booked, 0)) FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, delivery_month, sum(placements) AS booked FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY product_id, delivery_month) b ON b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month WHERE i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-10-01'

question: How many stalled deals does each sales rep have?
reference_sql: SELECT r.full_name, count(*) FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps r ON r.rep_id = o.owner_rep_id WHERE o.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND o.last_activity_date < DATE '2026-09-30' - 30 GROUP BY r.full_name

question: Which clients spent more this quarter than last quarter?
reference_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT o.account_id, sum(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') AS q2, sum(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30') AS q3 FROM bookings b JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id = b.opportunity_id WHERE b.status = 'active' GROUP BY o.account_id) SELECT a.account_name, COALESCE(q.q3, 0) - COALESCE(q.q2, 0) FROM q JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = q.account_id WHERE COALESCE(q.q3, 0) > COALESCE(q.q2, 0)

question: Who were our top 3 clients by net booked value in Q3 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT a.account_name, sum(b.amount) AS v FROM bookings b JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id = b.opportunity_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE b.status = 'active' AND b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY a.account_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show net booked value for each month of Q3 2026, by booking date.
reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', booking_date), sum(amount) FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' AND booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1

question: Which products sold more than 10% of their September 2026 inventory?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, delivery_month, sum(placements) AS booked FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY product_id, delivery_month) b ON b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month WHERE i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND 100.0 * COALESCE(b.booked, 0) / NULLIF(i.total_placements, 0) > 10
